title: Amazon SageMaker AI: building your own models

kcs.statement: Amazon SageMaker AI is a fully managed platform for data scientists to build, train and deploy custom machine learning models at scale.
Choose SageMaker AI when you need a custom model trained on your own data for a unique problem; choose a managed AI service when a pre-trained API already does the task.

problem_ideas: Predict machine failure from a factory's own sensor history: SageMaker or a managed AI service?
Translate support tickets: should the team train a model in SageMaker? Explain.
Order the ML lifecycle: prepare data, train, evaluate, deploy, monitor.
Spot the distractor: 'SageMaker is a chatbot for end users.'
A data science team wants managed Jupyter notebooks and one-click deployment: which service?
Classify five requirements as 'custom model' or 'pre-trained API'.
